sentence: This project tests whether deep brain stimulation is effective and safe for bipolar depression, using mobile monitoring to watch for signs of mania.
This project studies inherited DNA changes in men with prostate cancer to improve risk prediction and to test tailored cancer screening for relatives.
This project builds an MRI method that images several molecules at once at high speed to help characterize tissue.
This project designs proteins that control how growth factors in the transforming growth factor beta family fold, are made and work.
This project tests a cellular immunotherapy using memory-like natural killer cells in patients whose acute myeloid leukemia returned after a bone marrow transplant.
This project studies how fungi that live in soil survive when metals such as copper are scarce, as they are during infection.
This project supports a laboratory course on advanced molecular techniques used in neuroscience.
This project studies how the ventral tegmental area helps drive motivated behavior through neural circuits.
This project tests whether measurements taken from images can help detect cancer early and reduce problems with cancer screening.
This project builds computer tools that predict how proteins interact, including disordered proteins, to look for peptide treatments for diabetic wound healing.
This project studies how bacterial CRISPR-Cas9 systems form an antiviral DNA memory and how viruses escape it.
This project develops better ways to estimate background signal in PET images so that measurements stay accurate for cancer patients.
This project studies how a type of glutamate receptor that organizes synapses affects brain changes and movement problems in Parkinson's disease.
This project studies how molecules that bind the human serotonin transporter change its shape and control how it works.
This project studies immune and microbiome profiles in infants to find early signs that predict health outcomes in children.
This project studies how positive psychosocial well-being relates to kidney and heart health in Black women with and without lupus.
This project studies how pararubulaviruses enter human cells and cause disease in a small animal model.
This project combines experimental evolution with genome comparisons to find how difficult-to-treat bacteria become resistant to antibiotics.
This project develops magnetic resonance imaging methods to monitor remyelination in multiple sclerosis without surgery.
This project tests whether alternative polyadenylation, a way cells process RNA, controls how genes lead to an obese phenotype.
